snippet.title: PSX Longplay [320] EOS: Edge of Skyhigh
snippet.description:
http://www.longplays.org

Played by: MadMatty

Finally a short game to record! A Japanese only release, shoot em up with a story. Being in Japanese I have no idea what is going on in the game. I just shoot stuff, win go home and do the prom queen.

 The game seems to be a cross between Vanark and Night striker that i have played recently. A 3d on rails shooter in which you have to be constantly circling the screen to not get hit. It is hard to make out any details as you always have to be moving. You can choose between two forms but neither are great in all situations, so its more of a case of missiles or rapid fire cannon. -
Disclaimer: Most videos by World of Longplays use SaveStates!
